ideas.name: Short BTC Across Funding
ideas.claim: Open a BTC/USDT perpetual short shortly before a positive funding settlement and close shortly afterward to receive funding.
ideas.quote: Yes: this is how funding works, you could profit from this by opening/closing just before and after funding.

rules.entry: Short shortly before settlement when funding is positive; one minute before is given as an example.
rules.exit: Close shortly after settlement; exact timing not stated.

ideas.claimed_result: The page gives a hypothetical funding receipt of 1.13 USDT on a 1 BTC position valued at 11,363 USDT with a 0.01% funding rate; total trade result is not stated.
required_data: Historical funding rates and settlement times
